result.topic_en: Condition equations for determining the instrumental errors (collimation, inclination, azimuth-type constants) of a meridian/transit instrument from observations in reversed positions, followed by sketched dimensions of the thread intervals in the reticle of the meridian circle (S.M.Z.?) in 1823.
result.transcription:
Gleichungs[?]
$a\cos h + i\sin h + c + \alpha = s\cos h$
$a'\cos h + i'\sin h + c' + \beta = s\cos h$

$\left.\begin{array}{l} a\cos\theta - i\sin\theta - c + \eta \\ -a'\cos\theta + i'\sin\theta - c' \end{array}\right\} = -\gamma = +\delta$

$a\cos H - i\sin H - c + \zeta = n\cos H$
$a'\cos H - i'\sin H - c' + \varepsilon = n\cos H$

also

1) $\gamma + \delta = 0$
2) $2c = \beta + \gamma - \alpha$
3) $2c' = \gamma + \varepsilon - \zeta$
4) $n = a - c + \zeta$
$n = a' - c' + \varepsilon$ $\qquad$ 6. $i = c - \frac{1}{2}\eta$
5) $s = a + c + \alpha$
$s = a' + c' + \beta$
